messages.subject: Trouble viewing summary results
parts:
I'm sure I'm just doing something wrong here, because I'm new to R, but any advice would be appreciated.

Has anyone else experienced issues viewing output? It's not giving me any error messages and my model seems to have gone through ok, but I'm not seeing the results after inputing:

fit <- sem(model1, sample.cov = data.cor, sample.nobs = 473)
summary(fit,standardized=TRUE)
fit<- sem(model2, sample.cov = data.cor,sample.nobs = 473)
summary(fit,standardized=TRUE)
